title: Flock search audit CSV (platform export)
summary:
Asks for the Flock platform's search-audit CSV export — the per-search log that the platform records.

Each row includes the searcher's name and agency, timestamp, justification field, and offense type. 19,282 rows have been produced so far across SMPD's network.

policy_promises.tests: How does the platform-native audit CSV compare to what the monthly memos summarize?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012461 produced the monthly audit memos. This request covers the underlying platform CSV the memos summarize.

filed_because: The monthly memos summarize results without listing the individual searches. The CSV is the platform-level record — which searches ran, by whom, with what stated justification.
notes:
SMPD enabled public search_audit_csv visibility on the Flock transparency portal between 2026-05-04 and 2026-05-11, partway through this production.

Date-qualify any 'SMPD omits this' claims against that timeline. Rolling production continues.
